profile.name: BioShake 加热振荡器
profile.description: 一体化的加热与振荡平台，用于固定并振荡微孔板或样品托盘。设备带有可夹紧的板夹机构、温控单元（加热，可能支持主动冷却）以及可调速的振荡/加速/减速控制，常用于样品孵育、混匀和温控反应。
profile.description_en: An integrated heater and orbital shaker platform for clamping and agitating microplates or sample trays. The device includes a plate-clamping mechanism, temperature control (heating, with possible active cooling support), and adjustable shaking speed, acceleration and deceleration—used for incubating, mixing and temperature-controlled sample processing.

registry.name: BioShake iQ Microplate Shaker
registry.description: BioShake iQ Microplate Shaker 恒温摇床是由Q.Instruments (Analytik Jena)生产的恒温摇床，主要功能包括停止、冷却、复位、归零、温度设置、电流读取。
